B. cā̃i 'a caste of vegetable growers in Rajsahi' (c- ?). kṣīraśāka-, śaṇaśāka-.

assignments.Notes: CDIAL 12370 subsection 1 śāka potherb/vegetable explicitly gives Shina šā and Palula šō. Rajapurohit p. 107 item 930 śā vegetable matches the Shina form with loss of medial k; distinguish this from subsection 2 śākin vegetable grower and from the teak-tree homonym in 12369.
